ofac.description: OFAC SDN Ethereum addresses, nightly snapshot maintained by brave-intl.
ofac.label: sanctioned
ofac.note: Current 2026 snapshot. Sanctions are not permanent; as_of records the exact snapshot. Tornado Cash-related entries were delisted from OFAC in 2025 and are not treated as automatically sanctioned forever.

darklist.description: MyEtherWallet community darklist of malicious/scam Ethereum addresses.
darklist.label: darklist
darklist.note: Community-curated, not adjudicated; file has not changed since 2020, so the snapshot date is the commit date.

kaggle.description: Kaggle Ethereum Fraud Detection Dataset (Vagif Aliyev), mirrored on GitHub for reproducible download.
kaggle.label: fraud
kaggle.note: Only FLAG=1 rows are positives. Label quality is assumed uniform, hence default confidence 0.9.
